title: Proteomic and Transcriptomic Analyses Define Molecular Subtypes, Identify Biomarkers, and Suggest Potential Therapeutic Agent for Early-Stage HBV-Related Hepatocellular Carcinoma.
authors: Ge, Ying; Li, Junjun; Ming, Chen; Ung, Carolina Oi Lam; Lai, Yunfeng; Hu, Hao
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过蛋白质组和转录组分析定义HBV相关肝癌分子亚型并预测药物，虽涉及分子对接但核心是肿瘤分型与预后，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制研究。
abstract: Molecular heterogeneity in hepatitis B virus (HBV)-associated hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) complicates patient stratification. Here, we perform integrative proteomic analysis on 272 early stage HBV-HCC tumors from four East Asian cohorts, uncovering two robust molecular subtypes. Group B (n = 53) is associated with hyperproliferation, oncogenic signaling, and significantly poorer overall (P <0.001) and relapse-free survival (P <0.05). In contrast, group A (n = 219) is enriched in differentiation and metabolic pathways. These findings are validated by matched transcriptomics (n = 108), aligning with established classifications. We identify subtype-specific protein signatures, with CD46, HNF1A, and ATP1B1 exclusively expressed in the aggressive group B. Finally, computational drug sensitivity prediction, validated by molecular docking, nominates Sunitinib as a potential therapy for group B patients. Our work provides a proteomic framework for improved prognostication and targeted therapy in high-risk HBV-HCC.
abstract_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒（HBV）相关肝细胞癌（HCC）中的分子异质性使患者分层复杂化。在此，我们对来自四个东亚队列的272例早期HBV-HCC肿瘤进行了整合蛋白质组学分析，揭示了两种稳健的分子亚型。B组（n = 53）与过度增殖、致癌信号传导以及显著较差的总生存期（P <0.001）和无复发生存期（P <0.05）相关。相比之下，A组（n = 219）富集于分化及代谢通路。这些发现通过匹配的转录组学（n = 108）得到验证，并与已建立的分类一致。我们识别出亚型特异性蛋白质特征，其中CD46、HNF1A和ATP1B1仅在侵袭性B组中表达。最后，通过分子对接验证的计算药物敏感性预测，提名舒尼替尼（Sunitinib）作为B组患者的潜在治疗选择。我们的工作为改善高风险HBV-HCC的预后判断和靶向治疗提供了蛋白质组学框架。
